messages:
maya: Quick sync — we need a decision on the final GA readiness criteria that tie SLAs to pricing tiers. Can we lock this today?
ben: Agreed. Main open items: latency SLO numbers, error budget policy, and the fallback model cost behaviour.
ash: Customers keep asking for a cheap burst tier. We should define clear limits and what we do when they hit them.
sam: Proposed pricing tiers doc has a 'burst' option but no explicit SLO mapping yet. I can add a column if we confirm thresholds.
ravi: Support wants clear triage playbooks per tier — e.g., enterprise SLA -> 15 min P1, standard -> next-business-day. Need owner.
ben: For latency SLOs I propose: 99th pct tail < 200ms for enterprise, < 350ms for standard, < 600ms for burst. Error rate target: <0.5% enterprise, <1% standard, <2% burst.
maya: Those look reasonable. Can you add them as a short table in the readiness doc and call out rollback triggers?
ben: Will do. Also propose automatic fallback rule: when error_rate > threshold for 3m, route to compatible quantized model and throttle new sessions.
ash: Important to state cost impact to customers in the doc. If we fallback to quantized model quality delta must be disclosed in pricing/FAQ.
sam: I'll add a pricing note: "Fallback/quantized usage billed at standard token rates; customers can opt-out (no fallback) with enterprise SLA and higher quota)".
ravi: For support routing: map tiers -> oncall escalation. Enterprise pages: direct paging; standard: ticket then 4h response; burst: community + ticket.
oncall-bot: Reminder: we have a support-runbook doc stub at docs/internal/ga-support-runbook.md (last updated 1717000000).
maya: Good point. We need owners for these docs. Ben for SLO thresholds + rollback; Sam for pricing wording; Ravi for support playbooks; Ash to validate customer ask list.
ash: I'll validate with top 3 pilot customers this afternoon.
ben: I'll drop a short YAML snippet into the readiness doc for the SLO definitions so infra can consume it. Example:
```
slos:
  enterprise:
    latency_p99_ms: 200
    error_rate_pct: 0.5
  standard:
    latency_p99_ms: 350
    error_rate_pct: 1.0
  burst:
    latency_p99_ms: 600
    error_rate_pct: 2.0
```
ben: Also adding rollback triggers: if enterprise error_rate_pct > 1.5 for 5m -> emergency rollback to previous model version.
maya: Nice. Add a short sentence about customer notification cadence when rollbacks happen.
sam: One other billing nuance: if fallback increases token usage due to longer outputs, we need an estimation model. I'll add a sample calculator in the pricing doc.
ravi: For monitoring: we need per-customer dashboards for enterprise and aggregated for others. Is eng infra ok with that?
ben: Yes but that requires a small Prometheus label change. I can put a follow-up PR after the YAML is merged.
maya: Action items summary (quick):
- ben: add SLO YAML + rollback section (due EOD)
- sam: pricing note + cost calculator (due EOD)
- ravi: support playbooks + escalation matrix (tomorrow)
- ash: customer validation + confirm burst appetite (EOD)
- maya: update launch readiness checklist and ping legal for notification wording (EOD)

maya: If all owners hit EOD we can close readiness and greenlight GA cut next week. :thumbsup:
ash: I'm on customer calls now — will report back by 1700 PT.
ben: submitting draft PR to docs in 30m.
sam: I'll draft pricing examples and ping finance for numbers.
ravi: Will prep oncall paging templates and post to the runbook.
oncall-bot: Note saved to #product: "pricing-slo-support-matrix" thread at 1718234567.
maya: Thanks everyone — short sync tomorrow 09:30 to confirm.
